methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
This source scopes the UN Digital Library (Invenio) to Security Council documents — symbols beginning `S/`: resolutions (`S/RES/...`), presidential statements (`S/PRST/...`), letters and reports (`S/2016/...`), and meeting records (`S/PV.`). It is the only sibling source that exposes Council voting/adoption data (MARC 996).

## Search
Endpoint `https://digitallibrary.un.org/search`, `p` for the query, `of=recjson`. Scope to the Council with `191__b:"S/"`; narrow to resolutions with `191__a:"S/RES"` or fetch an exact resolution with `191__a:"S/RES/2321 (2016)"` (note the space and year-in-parentheses in the symbol). Combine with `year:2016` and Boolean operators.

## Filters
Symbol scope is the Council prefix (pre-set). `ln` sets interface language; `sf`/`so` sort. Full-text language is selected at download by filename suffix.

## Pagination
Offset-1: `jrec` = 1-based first-record index, `rg` = page size; page N = `jrec=(N-1)*rg+1`.

## Download
PDFs at `/record/{recid}/files/{filename}`, prefer `-EN.pdf`. Resolution filenames are URL-encoded, e.g. `S_RES_2321_%282016%29-EN.pdf`. 302 → `/nanna/...` → `application/pdf` (verified).

## Metadata & Enrichment
MARC21 XML at `/record/{recid}/export/xm?` (WAF-safe) is authoritative and uniquely carries the **voting record in field 996** (adoption result and meeting number), alongside 191 symbol, 245 title, 650 subjects, 981 'Security Council' body and 856 file links.

## Limitations
Scope is `S/` symbols only — no GA/ECOSOC documents. Voting field 996 is present on resolution records but not on every S/ document type. The `/search` list endpoint is AWS-WAF-challenged (HTTP 202) for server-to-server calls; `export/xm` and `files` are not, so per-record enrichment and download are reliable while result-listing needs a challenge solver.
